segments.1JN.1.3-4: John writes so believers will join in fellowship with God
segments.1JN.1.5-7: God is light, so believers must walk in the light
segments.1JN.1.8-10: Believers who confess sins are forgiven by God
segments.1JN.2.4-6: Believers must obey Jesus and live as he lived
segments.1JN.2.7-8: John writes about an old commandment that is also new
segments.1JN.2.9-11: Anyone who hates a fellow believer is in the darkness
segments.1JN.2.12-14: John writes to children, fathers and young men
segments.1JN.2.20-21: Believers have an anointing from God and know the truth
segments.1JN.2.22-23: Whoever denies the Son also denies the Father
segments.1JN.2.24-26: John urges believers to keep the first teaching
segments.1JN.2.27-29: Believers can be confident when Christ appears
segments.1JN.3.1-3: Believers will be like Christ when he appears
segments.1JN.3.4-6: Christ takes away sin; believers should not keep sinning
segments.1JN.3.7-8: The Son of God came to destroy the devil’s works
segments.1JN.3.9-10: Those born of God do what is right and love believers
segments.1JN.3.11-12: John tells believers to love, not to be like Cain
segments.1JN.3.13-15: Believers who love have passed from death to life
segments.1JN.3.16-18: Believers should love with actions, not only words
segments.1JN.3.19-22: Believers who obey God can ask him with confidence
segments.1JN.3.23-24: God commands believers to trust Jesus and love each other
segments.1JN.4.1-3: John tells believers to test every spirit
segments.1JN.4.4-6: Believers are from God and have overcome false prophets
segments.1JN.4.7-8: Believers should love one another because God is love
segments.1JN.4.9-10: God showed his love by sending his Son for our sins
segments.1JN.4.11-14: God remains in believers who love one another
segments.1JN.4.15-16: Whoever confesses Jesus as God’s Son remains in God
segments.1JN.4.17-18: Perfect love drives out fear of punishment
segments.1JN.4.19-21: Whoever loves God must also love other believers
segments.1JN.5.1-3: Loving God means keeping his commands, which are not hard
segments.1JN.5.4-5: Faith in Jesus as God’s Son overcomes the world
segments.1JN.5.6-8: The Spirit, the water and the blood testify about Jesus
segments.1JN.5.9-10: Whoever does not believe God’s testimony calls God a liar
segments.1JN.5.11-12: God gave eternal life, and this life is in his Son
segments.1JN.5.16-17: Believers should pray for a believer who sins
segments.1JN.5.18-19: God protects believers, but the world is under the evil one
segments.1JN.5.20-21: Jesus is the true God; John tells believers to avoid idols
